name: YouTrack for Orca
description: Browse YouTrack issues in the right sidebar and start coding agents on them.

settings.title: Default query
settings.description: YouTrack search query used when a server is first opened, before any search there.

settings.title: Issue list columns
settings.description: Columns after ID and Summary, in order, separated by commas: custom fields such as State or Fix versions, and Created or Updated (at most 10). A field no listed issue has a value for is left out.

settings.title: Branch name template
settings.description: Name of the new workspace and branch.

settings.title: Default agent
settings.description: Agent id preselected in the Start view; empty means terminal only.

settings.title: Default launch mode
settings.description: "Run in" choice preselected in the Start view.

settings.title: Start agents without a prompt
settings.description: Start the agent with no prompt, waiting for you in its terminal. Changeable for each start in the Start view.

settings.title: Include issue description
settings.description: Whether the "Include issue description in prompt" switch starts on in the Start view.

settings.title: Include mentioned articles
settings.description: Whether the "Include mentioned articles" switch starts on in the Start view: the prompt then asks the agent to read the knowledge base articles the issue mentions, with youtrack article view.

settings.title: Agent comments when done
settings.description: Whether the "Comment on the issue when done" switch starts on in the Start view: the prompt then asks the agent to add a comment that sums up its work.

settings.title: State when done
settings.description: Values the Start view offers first for the agent to set when done, separated by commas, such as In Review, Review: the first one the issue's field has is chosen. A choice made in Start for a YouTrack project is offered there instead.

settings.title: YouTrack CLI path
settings.description: Leave empty to find the YouTrack CLI automatically.
